# City of Ridgefield, Washington

> > Official website for the City of Ridgefield, WA, providing municipal services, public works information, development resources, and community programs.

Ridgefield is a growing city in Clark County, Washington, located in the Pacific Northwest near Vancouver and the Lewis River to Vancouver Lake Water Trail. The city manages utilities, parks, environmental programs, and maintains historic downtown areas including Pioneer Street.

## Key Topics

- Public Works & Utilities
- Building Permits & Development
- Water Conservation & Quality
- Stormwater Management
- City Council & Municipal Government
- Parks & Recreation
- Environmental Conservation
- Transportation & Streets
- Downtown Historic District
- Lake River & Water Trail
- Ridgefield National Wildlife Refuge
- Community Resources
- Municipal Codes & Ordinances
- SEPA & Land Use
- Backyard Habitat Certification

## City Government & Administration

- [City Council](https://ridgefieldwa.us/163/City-Council): City Council members, meeting schedule, and public attendance info
- [Human Resources](https://ridgefieldwa.us/203/Human-Resources): HR department managing employment, benefits, and labor relations
- [Municipal Codes](https://ridgefieldwa.us/265/Municipal-Codes): Access to City of Ridgefield ordinances via Municode Library
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://ridgefieldwa.us/FAQ.aspx): FAQ covering Public Works, utilities, permits, and city services

## Public Works & Utilities

- [Water Service](https://ridgefieldwa.us/225/Water-Service): Water Division operations, quality testing, and utility infrastructure
- [Stormwater Management](https://ridgefieldwa.us/235/Stormwater-Management): Stormwater Division managing MS4 permit compliance and water quality
- [Streets & Transportation](https://ridgefieldwa.us/221/Streets-Transportation): Street maintenance, transportation planning, and infrastructure programs
- [Water Conservation - Normal](https://ridgefieldwa.us/292/Water-Conservation---Normal): Water conservation tips and best practices for residential users

## Building & Development

- [Application Requirements & Checklists](https://ridgefieldwa.us/184/Application-Requirements-Checklists): Building permit application requirements and submittal checklists
- [Home Improvement](https://ridgefieldwa.us/186/Home-Improvement): Building permit requirements and benefits for home improvement projects
- [Development Public Notices](https://ridgefieldwa.us/331/Development-Public-Notices): Public notices for land use, site plans, SEPA reviews, and development

## Parks, Recreation & Environment

- [Ridgefield Outdoor Recreation Complex](https://ridgefieldwa.us/296/Ridgefield-Outdoor-Recreation-Complex): 53-acre RORC sports facility for Ridgefield School District and community
- [Our Environment](https://ridgefieldwa.us/260/Our-Environment): Environmental conservation, water/energy efficiency, and habitat programs
- [Find a Trail](https://ridgefieldwa.us/218/Find-a-Trail): Trail network directory including Ridgefield National Wildlife Refuge trails
- [Big Paddle Waterfront Festival](https://ridgefieldwa.us/302/Big-Paddle-Waterfront-Festival): Annual waterfront festival with Lake River paddle event on National Trails Day

## Community Resources

- [Hospitals & Healthcare](https://ridgefieldwa.us/249/Hospitals-Healthcare): Directory of hospitals and medical centers near Ridgefield, WA
- [Community Organizations](https://ridgefieldwa.us/259/Community-Organizations): Directory of civic groups and volunteer organizations in Ridgefield

## Optional

- [Old Liberty Theater](https://ridgefieldwa.us/405/Old-Liberty-Theater): Historic downtown storyboard about Old Liberty Theater movie house
- [Sweet Shop and Time Capsule](https://ridgefieldwa.us/410/Sweet-Shop-and-Time-Capsule): Historic downtown storyboard about Schroeder's Sweet Shop and time capsule
